srcZh: 国家知识产权局（知识产权报）
titleZh: 嘉宾精彩发言（摘编2）：人工智能与知识产权
titleEn: Highlights of Guest Speeches (Part 2): AI and Intellectual Property
sumZh: 多位嘉宾指出，人工智能正深度重构产业与生活，知识产权制度应持续回应AI技术发展，完善审查政策、强化数据筑基与算法赋能，并以开放心态推动AI在知识产权领域的稳妥应用。
sumEn: Multiple experts argue that AI is reshaping industry and daily life, and the IP system must keep pace by refining examination policies, strengthening data foundations and algorithm empowerment, while applying AI in IP services prudently.

srcZh: 国家知识产权局（光明日报）
titleZh: 全国政协委员申长雨：加强人工智能领域知识产权保护
titleEn: CPPCC Member Shen Changyu: Strengthen IP Protection in the AI Field
sumZh: 申长雨表示中国已成为全球人工智能专利最大拥有国，国家知识产权局将推动建立人工智能大模型领域专利池，畅通与企业常态化沟通，助力AI企业创新发展。
sumEn: Shen Changyu notes China has become the world's largest holder of AI patents, and CNIPA will promote patent pools for large AI models and maintain regular communication with enterprises to support innovation.

srcZh: 同济大学上海国际知识产权学院
srcEn: Tongji University Shanghai International College of IP
titleZh: 会议观点综述｜数字创新、人工智能与知识产权
titleEn: Conference Review: Digital Innovation, AI and Intellectual Property
sumZh: 论坛汇集青年学者围绕数字经济、AI赋能新质生产力与数据知识产权保护展开研讨，指出AI在训练数据、生成内容权属等方面带来全新知识产权问题，需立法与技术快速迭代应对。
sumEn: The forum gathered young scholars to discuss the digital economy, AI empowering new quality productivity and data IP protection, highlighting that AI raises novel IP issues around training data and ownership of generated content requiring rapid legislative and technical iteration.

srcEn: Ministry of Science and Technology (Science and Technology Daily)
titleZh: 在2025中国知识产权保护高层论坛上，专家表示——AI时代知识产权需科学的智慧和制度的理性
titleEn: At the 2025 China IP Protection High-Level Forum, Experts Say IP in the AI Era Needs Scientific Wisdom and Institutional Rationality
sumZh: 吴汉东等专家提出应重构知识产权制度价值，坚持安全与创新并重，有条件承认机器作者与机器发明，将AI生成物纳入客体范围但坚持人本主义原则。
sumEn: Experts such as Wu Handong propose rebuilding the value of the IP system, balancing safety and innovation, conditionally recognizing machine authors and inventions, and bringing AI-generated output within the scope of protectable subject matter while upholding anthropocentrism.

titleZh: 2024全球数字经济大会“人工智能产业发展与知识产权保护”专题论坛在京举行
titleEn: 2024 Global Digital Economy Conference Holds Forum on AI Industry Development and IP Protection
sumZh: 论坛汇聚行政、司法、高校与企业界嘉宾，探讨AI法律地位、生成内容著作权及刑事合规风险，并发布数据知识产权登记系统与多项研究成果，强调产学研协同赋能AI产业。
sumEn: The forum brought together government, judicial, academic and industry speakers to discuss AI's legal status, copyright in generated content and criminal compliance risks, and released a data IP registration system and research outputs, stressing industry-academia collaboration.

srcZh: 安徽省产权交易中心（王耀）
titleZh: 大数据时代：数据知识产权的“时”与“势”
titleEn: The "Time" and "Trend" of Data IP in the Big Data Era
sumZh: 文章梳理数据知识产权政策与17个试点省市实践，指出登记规则不统一、配套制度待完善、企业主动性不足等挑战，建议推动全国统一登记制度并完善交易与协同保护机制。
sumEn: The article reviews data IP policies and the practice of 17 pilot regions, noting challenges such as inconsistent registration rules and weak enterprise initiative, and recommends a unified national registration system with better trading and collaborative protection mechanisms.

srcZh: 中国金融信息网（新华财经）
titleZh: 国家知识产权局：目前17个试点地方接收数据知识产权登记申请超1.3万份
titleEn: CNIPA: 17 Pilot Regions Have Received Over 13,000 Data IP Registration Applications
sumZh: 国家知识产权局介绍全国17个省市开展数据知识产权试点，已颁发证书超7000张，提出构建数据知识产权保护“四个充分”原则，并在司法裁判中应用登记证书。
sumEn: CNIPA reported that 17 provinces and cities are piloting data IP protection, with over 7,000 certificates issued, and proposed the "four fullys" principles for protecting data IP, with registration certificates already used in judicial disputes.

titleZh: 我国数据知识产权登记制度试点改革路径研究
titleEn: Research on the Pilot Reform Path of China's Data IP Registration System
sumZh: 研究厘清数据、数据集合与数据产品的内涵，指出数据知识产权登记以特定数据集合为对象、以数据处理者为有限排他权主体，建议明确审查标准并强化部门协同与区块链赋能。
sumEn: The study clarifies the concepts of data, data sets and data products, argues that data IP registration targets specific data sets with data processors as subjects of limited exclusive rights, and recommends clear examination standards plus coordinated supervision and blockchain support.

srcZh: 国家知识产权局（人民日报）
titleZh: 专利护航，企业出海底气足
titleEn: Patents Escort Enterprises Going Global with Confidence
sumZh: 文章以宇树科技、宁德时代等为例，指出知识产权“出海”关乎企业成长与国家发展大局，建议企业“市场未动、专利先行”，探索技术授权与产业专利池模式。
sumEn: Citing cases such as Unitree and CATL, the article argues that IP "going global" matters for both enterprises and the nation, and advises "patents first before markets," exploring technology licensing and industry patent pools.

titleZh: 《商标法》及其实施条例修改专家座谈研讨会在中央财经大学召开
titleEn: Expert Symposium on Revision of the Trademark Law and Implementing Regulations Held at CUFE
sumZh: 李顺德、马一德等专家就加大恶意注册规制、完善授权确权程序、促进商标使用等议题发表看法，认为本轮全面修法正逢其时、体现开门立法。
sumEn: Experts including Li Shunde and Ma Yide commented on curbing bad-faith filings, improving examination procedures and promoting trademark use, viewing the comprehensive revision as timely and demonstrating open legislation.

titleZh: 专家详解商标法修订草案（征求意见稿）
titleEn: Experts Explain the Trademark Law Revision Draft (Exposure Draft)
sumZh: 文章梳理征求意见稿在淡化驰名商标行政认定、缩短公告期、规制恶意注册、提高代理门槛等方面的修改，认为修法有助于解决商标领域突出问题、促进高质量发展。
sumEn: The article outlines revisions such as de-emphasizing administrative well-known mark recognition, shortening opposition periods, curbing bad-faith filings and raising agency thresholds, arguing the revision addresses prominent trademark issues and promotes high-quality development.

titleZh: 著作权法第三次修改的重要内容及价值考量
titleEn: Key Contents and Value Considerations of the Third Revision of the Copyright Law
sumZh: 作者石宏指出第三次修法完善作品定义、视听作品归属、广播权与合理使用制度，并引入惩罚性赔偿与举证妨碍规则，为鼓励创作传播提供制度保障。
sumEn: Author Shi Hong notes the third revision improves the definition of works, audiovisual work ownership, broadcasting rights and fair use, and introduces punitive damages and burden-of-proof rules, safeguarding creation and dissemination.

titleZh: 新《著作权法》正式实施 专家：为“原创的你”保驾护航
titleEn: New Copyright Law Takes Effect; Expert: Protecting "Original You"
sumZh: 管育鹰认为新法以更弹性的合理使用规则增强保护、兼顾公众利益，将“时事新闻”改为“单纯事实消息”厘清新闻作品保护边界，为原创佳作保驾护航。
sumEn: Guan Yuying argues the new law enhances protection with more flexible fair-use rules while balancing public interests, and changing "current news" to "mere factual information" clarifies the boundaries of news copyright protection.

srcZh: 南方日报/南方+（腾讯新闻）
titleZh: 专家解读新修订著作权法：新闻作品受保护，不能随意转载
titleEn: Experts Interpret the Revised Copyright Law: News Works Are Protected, Not Free to Repost
sumZh: 肖胜方、田绘解读新法提高惩罚性赔偿上限至五倍、将“时事新闻”改为“单纯事实消息”，认为这有助于遏制洗稿与随意转载等侵权现象。
sumEn: Xiao Shengfang and Tian Hui explain that the revised law raises punitive damages up to five times and changes "current news" to "mere factual information," helping curb plagiarism and unauthorized reposting.

titleZh: 新修订《著作权法》亮点解读：十年磨一剑
titleEn: Highlights of the Revised Copyright Law: A Decade in the Making
sumZh: 文章从实务角度解读新法开放式作品条款、视听作品统一、广播权重构及惩罚性赔偿等制度，认为修法更务实并回应了新技术带来的法律挑战。
sumEn: From a practitioner's view, the article interprets the open-ended work clause, unified audiovisual works, reconstructed broadcasting rights and punitive damages, concluding the revision is more pragmatic and meets challenges from new technology.

srcZh: 国家知识产权局（学习交流）
titleZh: WIPO发布《标准必要专利战略（2024—2026）》
titleEn: WIPO Releases the Standard Essential Patents Strategy (2024–2026)
sumZh: 文章解读WIPO标准必要专利战略，指出其依据中立、互补与自愿原则，从全球对话论坛、知识与数据来源、友好协议场地和服务提供者四支柱推进SEP治理。
sumEn: The article explains WIPO's SEP strategy built on neutrality, complementarity and voluntariness, advancing SEP governance through four pillars: a global dialogue forum, knowledge and data hub, venue for amicable agreements, and service provider.

titleZh: 《标准必要专利发展报告（2024年）》全文公开发布
titleEn: Full Release of the Standard Essential Patents Development Report (2024)
sumZh: 报告基于300多万条标准数据挖掘，梳理国内外SEP政策、案例与数据，展望SEP协同创新赋能新质生产力的五大趋势，并提出政府、市场与科研机构相关建议。
sumEn: Based on over 3 million standards data, the report reviews domestic and international SEP policies, cases and data, forecasts five trends of SEP-enabled new quality productivity, and offers recommendations for government, market and research bodies.

srcZh: 国家标准化管理委员会（市场监管总局）
titleZh: 市场监管总局印发《标准必要专利反垄断指引》
titleEn: SAMR Issues the Antitrust Guidelines on Standard Essential Patents
sumZh: 指引明确SEP领域反垄断分析原则，强调兼顾知识产权保护与市场竞争、平衡权利人与实施方利益，细化信息披露、FRAND许可承诺与善意谈判等合规要求。
sumEn: The guidelines clarify the antitrust analysis principles for SEPs, emphasizing both IP protection and market competition and balancing patentees and implementers, with detailed compliance rules on disclosure, FRAND commitments and good-faith negotiation.

srcZh: 北京金诚同达律师事务所
titleZh: 中国企业出海的知识产权风险和防控策略
titleEn: IP Risks and Prevention Strategies for Chinese Enterprises Going Global
sumZh: 文章系统梳理跨境电商投诉、海外展会警告、337调查、海关扣押等常见风险，建议企业建立海外知识产权管理体系、加强布局与预警并提升应诉能力。
sumEn: The article systematically reviews common risks such as e-commerce complaints, overseas exhibition warnings, Section 337 investigations and customs seizures, and advises building overseas IP management systems, strengthening layout and early warning, and improving litigation response.

srcZh: 国家知识产权局（知识产权报）
titleZh: 知识产权乘风破浪 创新主体扬帆“出海”
titleEn: IP Rides the Wind and Waves as Innovators Set Sail to Go Global
sumZh: 全国两会代表委员建议以优化海外专利布局为切口提升全球竞争力，建立高效涉外知识产权保护机制，并加快制定对外投资法以协同保障企业出海。
sumEn: NPC and CPPCC members suggest using optimized overseas patent layout to boost global competitiveness, building efficient foreign-related IP protection mechanisms, and accelerating an outward investment law to support going global.

titleZh: 2024中国商业秘密法律保护年度回顾与观察
titleEn: Annual Review and Observation of Trade Secret Legal Protection in China (2024)
sumZh: 文章回顾2024年商业秘密民事、刑事与行政保护动态，指出“新能源汽车底盘案”判赔6.4亿创历史新高，最高法持续释放强保护信号并完善反法第三十二条适用规则。
sumEn: The article reviews civil, criminal and administrative trade secret protection in 2024, noting the "new energy vehicle chassis" case set a record 640-million-yuan award, with the Supreme Court signaling stronger protection and refining Article 32 of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law.

srcZh: 中国知识产权资讯网（中国知识产权报）
titleZh: 商业秘密保护的难点与热点，专家多角度来解读
titleEn: Experts Interpret the Difficulties and Hot Topics in Trade Secret Protection
sumZh: 谢焱、黄武双等专家从多维保护机制、罪责认定难点与人才流动平衡等角度解读，建议统一法律框架、完善鉴定标准并平衡商业秘密保护与公共利益。
sumEn: Experts including Xie Yan and Huang Wushuang interpret from multi-dimensional protection, criminal liability hurdles and talent mobility balance, recommending a unified legal framework, better appraisal standards and balancing protection with public interest.

srcEn: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
titleZh: 马一德 韩天舒：探索完善地理标志保护制度
titleEn: Ma Yide and Han Tianshu: Exploring and Improving the Geographical Indication Protection System
sumZh: 文章建议加快地理标志保护专门立法，对品质更优、声誉更好、质量可控的地理标志建立更完善保护机制，以支撑农业高质量发展与乡村振兴。
sumEn: The article recommends accelerating dedicated legislation for geographical indications and building stronger protection for high-quality, reputable and controllable GIs to support high-quality agricultural development and rural revitalization.

titleZh: 地理标志产品频频被“碰瓷” 国家知识产权局回应如何加强保护
titleEn: GI Products Frequently "Infringed"; CNIPA Responds on Strengthening Protection
sumZh: 国知局条法司司长张鹏表示中国采取商标保护与专门保护两种模式，并发布《地理标志产品保护办法》，从审查标准、管理义务与侵权规制三方面完善制度。
sumEn: CNIPA's Director Zhang Peng says China adopts both trademark and sui generis protection, and issued the Measures for GI Product Protection, improving the system through examination standards, management duties and infringement rules.

srcZh: 国际在线（中央广电总台）
titleZh: 专家称 中欧正式签署地理标志协定将进一步拓宽双方知识产权保护合作领域
titleEn: Experts: China-EU GI Agreement Broadens IP Cooperation
sumZh: 专家崔洪建等指出《中欧地理标志协定》是中国对外签署的首个全面高水平地理标志协定，将促进双边农产品贸易并为全球知识产权保护提供示范。
sumEn: Expert Cui Hongjian notes the China-EU GI Agreement is China's first comprehensive, high-level GI agreement, boosting bilateral agricultural trade and setting a global example for IP protection.

titleZh: 强化中医药知识产权司法保护
titleEn: Strengthening Judicial Protection of Traditional Chinese Medicine IP
sumZh: 文章解读最高法《关于加强中医药知识产权司法保护的意见》，建议明确中医药知识产权保护对象、平衡公共知识与私有技术，并完善商标、地理标志与秘方保护体系。
sumEn: The article interprets the Supreme Court's opinion on TCM IP judicial protection, recommending clarifying the protected subject matter, balancing public knowledge and private technology, and improving trademark, GI and secret-formula protection.

srcZh: 中国法院网（人民法院报）
titleZh: 传统中医药知识产权保护的实践与展望
titleEn: Practice and Prospects of Traditional Chinese Medicine IP Protection
sumZh: 文章梳理中医药著作权、商标、专利与商业秘密保护现状，指出知识产权流失与制度不适配等问题，建议建立契合中医药特性的特色保护制度并借鉴国际经验。
sumEn: The article reviews copyright, trademark, patent and trade secret protection of TCM, identifies IP drain and institutional misfit, and recommends a TCM-specific protection system drawing on international experience.

titleZh: 最高人民法院发布2024年人民法院知识产权典型案例
titleEn: Supreme People's Court Releases 2024 Typical IP Cases
sumZh: 典型案例覆盖专利、商标、著作权、商业秘密与AI技术等领域，明确“AI换脸”不构成合理使用、游戏玩法规则不受著作权保护等裁判规则，彰显司法引领。
sumEn: The typical cases span patents, trademarks, copyright, trade secrets and AI, clarifying rules such as "AI face-swapping" not being fair use and game mechanics not protected by copyright, showing judicial guidance.

titleZh: 宋健：惩罚性赔偿实证研究分析与思考
titleEn: Song Jian: Empirical Research and Reflections on Punitive Damages
sumZh: 江苏高院法官宋健基于实证数据指出惩罚性赔偿对制裁严重侵权必要，但适用过度易引发负面效果，应从实证研究出发审慎探讨适用条件。
sumEn: Judge Song Jian, based on empirical data, argues punitive damages are necessary against serious infringement but overuse may backfire, and calls for prudent discussion of application conditions grounded in empirical research.

srcZh: 腾讯新闻（魏启学律师事务所）
titleZh: 8件案例告诉你，知识产权侵权惩罚性赔偿如何适用和计算
titleEn: 8 Cases Explain How Punitive Damages Apply and Are Calculated in IP Infringement
sumZh: 文章结合司法解释梳理惩罚性赔偿的故意与情节严重两要件及基数、倍数计算方法，强调运用书证开示与举证妨碍规则破解“举证难、判赔低”。
sumEn: Combining judicial interpretations, the article explains the two elements (willfulness and seriousness) and the base/multiplier calculation of punitive damages, emphasizing document discovery and burden-shifting to solve proof and low-award difficulties.

srcZh: 新浪财经（中工网/新华社）
titleZh: 近200位业内权威专家在沪探讨知识产权的“未来之问”
titleEn: Nearly 200 Leading Experts in Shanghai Explore the "Future Questions" of IP
sumZh: 论坛聚焦大数据、人工智能给知识产权保护带来的挑战，专家认为应在中国大陆法框架下形成有效的数据财产保护体系，并应对智能驾驶等AI新赛道的知识产权生态。
sumEn: The forum focused on challenges from big data and AI, with experts arguing China should build an effective data-property protection system under the civil-law framework and address the IP ecosystem of AI tracks like autonomous driving.

titleZh: 趋势研判！2024年中国知识产权服务行业政策、产业链图谱、发展现状及竞争格局分析
titleEn: Trend Analysis: China's IP Service Industry in 2024 — Policy, Value Chain and Competition
sumZh: 文章研判知识产权服务行业营收持续增长、机构与人才规模扩大，并指出服务专业化、AI与大数据技术深化应用及全球化是未来三大发展趋势。
sumEn: The article forecasts continued revenue growth and expanding institutions/talent in IP services, identifying professionalization, deeper AI/big-data application and globalization as the three future trends.

srcZh: 国家知识产权局知识产权发展研究中心
titleZh: 知识产权强国建设发展报告（2024年）
titleEn: IP Powerful Nation Development Report (2024)
sumZh: 报告指出我国知识产权强国建设指数稳步提升，创造质量、保护力度与运用效益持续增强，并强调需加快构建大数据、人工智能等新领域新业态知识产权保护规则。
sumEn: The report shows the IP powerful-nation index rising steadily with better creation quality, stronger protection and greater use, stressing the need to build IP rules for new fields such as big data and AI.

srcZh: 国家知识产权局知识产权发展研究中心
titleZh: 《2024年度知识产权保护水平评估报告》正式发布
titleEn: 2024 IP Protection Level Evaluation Report Released
sumZh: 评估显示2024年我国知识产权保护水平总指数83.42，同比增长0.49%，各一级指标均较2021年提升，江苏位列省级行政区首位，重点城市示范带动明显。
sumEn: The evaluation shows China's overall IP protection index reached 83.42 in 2024, up 0.49%, with all first-level indicators higher than 2021; Jiangsu led provinces and key cities showed demonstrative effects.

titleZh: 申长雨：新时代知识产权强国建设的宏伟蓝图
titleEn: Shen Changyu: A Grand Blueprint for Building an IP Powerful Nation in the New Era
sumZh: 申长雨解读《知识产权强国建设纲要（2021—2035年）》，强调建设知识产权强国是现代化建设的必然要求，并提出建设六大方面重点任务一体推进。
sumEn: Shen Changyu interprets the Outline for Building an IP Powerful Nation (2021–2035), stressing it is essential for modernization and proposing six key task areas to be advanced in an integrated way.

srcZh: 贵阳市科技局（科技日报）
srcEn: Guiyang Science and Technology Bureau (Science and Technology Daily)
titleZh: 开启知识产权强国建设新征程——专家解读《知识产权强国建设纲要（2021—2035年）》

sumEn: Experts Li Shunde and Xiao Youdan view the Outline as an actionable "construction blueprint" signaling a strong expectation of IP as a national strategy, emphasizing faster legislation for big data, AI and other new fields.

titleZh: 开启知识产权强国建设新征程——专家解读《知识产权强国建设纲要（2021—2035年）》
titleEn: Starting the New Journey of IP Powerful Nation Building — Experts Interpret the Outline
sumZh: 专家赵礼杰等指出建设面向社会主义现代化的知识产权制度是最核心任务，建议相关部门多关注新业态新技术、制定科学合理的知识产权制度。
sumEn: Expert Zhao Lijie notes building a modern IP system is the core task, advising authorities to pay more attention to new business forms and technologies and formulate scientific, reasonable IP institutions.

titleEn: SCIO Press Conference Interprets How to Build a World-Class IP Powerful Nation

sumEn: The press conference explained four anticipatory indicators of the Outline; the Supreme Court pledged punitive damages and "three-in-one" adjudication reform, while SAMR vowed strict action against infringement and counterfeiting.

titleZh: 《二〇二四年中国知识产权保护状况》白皮书正式发布
titleEn: White Paper on China's IP Protection (2024) Released
sumZh: 白皮书从保护成效、制度建设、审批登记、文化建设与国际合五个方面介绍2024年进展，知识产权保护社会满意度升至82.36分再创新高。
sumEn: The white paper presents 2024 progress across protection effectiveness, institutions, registration, culture and international cooperation, with public satisfaction in IP protection rising to a record 82.36.

titleZh: 最高法：针对惩罚性赔偿的适用问题，正研究起草指导意见
titleEn: Supreme Court: Drafting Guidance on Application of Punitive Damages
sumZh: 最高法民三庭庭长李剑表示2024年全国法院对460起恶意情节严重案件适用惩罚性赔偿、同比增长44.2%，并正研究起草适用指导意见以细化裁判规则。
sumEn: Li Jian of the Supreme Court's Third Civil Division said in 2024 courts applied punitive damages in 460 willful and serious cases, up 44.2%, and are drafting guidance to refine the rules.

titleZh: 2025年全国知识产权局局长会议工作报告
titleEn: Work Report of the 2025 National IP Directors Conference
sumZh: 报告总结2024年知识产权审查周期压减、专利转化运用与保护力度加大等进展，并部署2025年完善法治、强化高质量创造与高标准保护等重点任务。
sumEn: The report summarizes 2024 progress in shorter examination, patent commercialization and stronger protection, and sets 2025 tasks on improving the legal system, high-quality creation and high-standard protection.

titleZh: 《专利审查指南》（2023）修改解读（五）——中药领域发明专利申请审查
titleEn: Interpretation of the 2023 Patent Examination Guidelines (V): Examination of TCM Invention Patent Applications
sumZh: 解读指出新增中药领域审查专章，针对中药组合物新颖性、创造性判断等特殊性统一标准，旨在加强中医药创新专利保护并提升国际话语权。
sumEn: The interpretation notes a new chapter on TCM examination that unifies standards for the novelty and inventiveness of Chinese medicine compositions, aiming to strengthen patent protection for TCM innovation and enhance international voice.

titleZh: 中国知识产权领域反垄断案例研究报告「2008-2025」（下）
titleEn: Research Report on Antitrust Cases in China's IP Field (2008–2025), Part II
sumZh: 报告解读2008—2025年26起知识产权反垄断案例（含12起标准必要专利案），指出知识产权须严守权利边界，未来需在保护智力成果与维护市场公平间动态平衡。
sumEn: The report analyzes 26 IP-related antitrust cases from 2008–2025 (including 12 SEP cases), noting IP as "lawful monopoly" must respect boundaries, and future balance is needed between protecting creations and market fairness.

titleZh: 【中医药知识产权保护】人民法院报：传统中医药知识产权保护的实践与展望

sumEn: The article reviews TCM protection via copyright, trademark, patent and trade secret, identifies drain and institutional misfit, and recommends a TCM-specific system drawing on Indian and Thai experience.

titleZh: 《商业秘密：行业视角与实战策略》

sumEn: Zhong Lun's collection systematically studies trade secret protection across healthcare, AI and software, covering legislation, cross-cutting issues and compliance, offering comprehensive guidance for enterprises and practitioners.

titleZh: 我国知识产权强国建设迈出新步伐
titleEn: China's IP Powerful Nation Building Takes New Steps

sumEn: The SCIO briefing used "six mores" to characterize progress, reviewed 40 years of the Patent Law, and addressed AI governance and crackdowns on pirated films.

titleZh: 国家知识产权局办公室关于确定2024年数据知识产权试点地方的通知
titleEn: CNIPA Notice on Designating 2024 Data IP Pilot Regions

sumEn: The notice adds 9 provinces/municipalities to the original 8 as 2024 data IP pilots, requiring adherence to the "four fullys" principles and building a sound registration management system with stronger protection and use.

titleZh: 媒体聚焦！2024全球数字经济大会这场专题论坛实力“吸睛”
titleEn: Media Spotlight on the 2024 Global Digital Economy Conference Forum
sumZh: 多家媒体聚焦“人工智能产业发展与知识产权保护”专题论坛，报道专家观点：AI生成内容作为作品受著作权法保护、生成物具有价值与稀缺性应受保护。
sumEn: Multiple media covered the "AI Industry Development and IP Protection" forum, reporting expert views that AI-generated content is protected as a work and generated output deserves protection for its value and scarcity.

titleEn: By the Numbers: 2024 IP and Patent Market Trends — Promoting IP Transactions and Financing
sumZh: 文章以2024年知识产权数据指出专利正从“保护工具”转变为可交易、可融资的“资产”，并分析专利质押融资、证券化等市场化新机遇。
sumEn: Using 2024 IP data, the article argues patents are shifting from a "protection tool" to tradable, financeable "assets," analyzing new opportunities such as patent pledge financing and securitization.

titleZh: 2021中国网络版权保护大会
titleEn: 2021 China Internet Copyright Protection Conference
sumZh: 全国人大法工委石宏解读著作权法第三次修改，强调加大侵权损害赔偿、增加惩罚性赔偿、新增举证妨碍制度以解决维权难题，法律的权威在于实施。
sumEn: Shi Hong of the NPC Legislative Affairs Commission interpreted the third Copyright Law revision, stressing heavier damages, punitive damages and a burden-of-proof obstacle rule to solve enforcement difficulties, noting a law's authority lies in its implementation.
